title: O'clock and half past on a clock
examples: How do I tell o'clock times?
Which hand is the hour hand?

explain.say: When does your favourite cartoon start? To find out, you read a clock! Look at the board. The long hand points straight up at 12, and the short hand points at 3. It is 3 o'clock.

draw.text: O'clock and half past on a clock

explain.say: Now look! Here it is in 3D: an analogue clock. Can you see the hour hand and the minute hand? Tap any part, and I will tell you about it.

draw.text: O'clock and half past on a clock

explain.say: The short hand is the hour hand. It tells you the hour. The long hand is the minute hand. When it points to 12, we say o'clock. So the short hand on 3 means 3 o'clock. Can you point to each hand?
Now the short hand points at 7, and the long hand is on 12 again. What time is it? Yes, 7 o'clock, maybe breakfast time in Jakarta or Nairobi!

Now watch the long hand move halfway round, from 12 down to 6. That is half an hour, 30 minutes. We call this half past 3. See the short hand? It is now halfway between 3 and 4. Why do you think it moved?
Well done, clock reader! This is half past 8. The long hand is on 6, and the short hand is between 8 and 9. Wow: the long hand goes all the way round 24 times every day! What time do you go to bed?

faq.q: How do I tell o'clock times?
faq.a: Look for the long minute hand pointing straight up at 12. Then read the number the short hour hand points to. If it points to 3, it is 3 o'clock.
Half past means 30 minutes after the hour. The long hand has gone halfway round and points to 6. Half past 3 is 30 minutes after 3 o'clock.

faq.q: Which hand is the hour hand?
faq.a: The short hand is the hour hand, and the long hand is the minute hand. The hour hand moves slowly, from one number to the next in one hour.
asks: Is the short hand the hour?

faq.q: Why is the hour hand between two numbers at half past?
faq.a: The hour hand moves slowly all the time. At half past 3, it has gone halfway from 3 to 4, because half of the hour has passed.
asks: Why does the short hand move at half past?

faq.q: How many minutes are in an hour?
faq.a: There are 60 minutes in an hour. The minute hand goes once all the way round the clock in 60 minutes.

facts: There are 60 minutes in an hour, and half an hour is 30 minutes.
The minute hand goes round the clock 24 times in a day, and the hour hand goes round twice.

quiz.say: The long hand points to 12 and the short hand points to 9. What time is it?
quiz.show: The long hand points to 12 and the short hand points to 9. What time is it?
quiz.why: The long hand on 12 means o'clock, and the short hand shows the hour: 9.

wrong.0: 12 is where the minute hand points, not the hour hand.
wrong.2: Half past needs the long hand on 6.

quiz.say: At half past 5, where does the long minute hand point?
quiz.show: At half past 5, where does the long minute hand point?
quiz.why: At half past, the minute hand has gone halfway round and points to 6.

wrong.0: 5 is near the short hour hand, not the minute hand.
wrong.1: 12 is where the minute hand points at o'clock.
